notes.subject: שלל/בז
notes.rationale: Infinitive + noun tupela kain — 'rausim plun, karim plun' — pasin i kamap wanpela, mi holim

notes.subject: טבור הארץ
notes.rationale: Tabur i min bel bilong bel — 'bel bilong graun' (sentra) o 'antap long graun'; mi tekem 'bel bilong graun'

notes.subject: מקנה
notes.gloss: מקנה em i ol animal bilong lukautim — bulmakau na sipsip, i no olgeta kain samting

translation: Bilong rausim plun, bilong karim plun; bilong tanim han bilong yu long ol ples ol i bagarupim pinis taim man i go bek stap long en, na long ol lain ol i kisim singaut i kam olgeta, long olgeta man bilong ol narapela kantri, ol i wokim olgeta ol bulmakau na sipsip na olgeta samting — ol i stap long bel bilong graun.
